description: Reference implementation of the module contract. Echoes a message back through the spine (auth, approval, billing) using a SIMULATED provider — proves the contract end to end without any real provider.
name: template_demo
provider_notes: SIMULATED provider only. Real mode requires ctx.auth_get('template_provider') to prove the AuthMissing path; destructive=true exercises ctx.approval_request. Never a real send.
